description: Klardaten DATEV-Connector gives authorized users controlled access to DATEV accounting, payroll (Lohn und Gehalt and LODAS), document management, order management, and master data through ChatGPT. It supports guided discovery, scoped list and detail lookups, financial reporting, DMS metadata and content search, document retrieval, order inspection, payroll snapshots, and master-data access. Large read results can be retrieved through authenticated attachments. With a separately approved OAuth permission, it can create uncommitted accounting sequences; it cannot finalize them. LODAS requires the exchange service to be enabled for the selected client. DMS content search is available only for eligible accounts. Access is limited to the DATEV data and operations permitted for the authenticated user.
